answer: Unique-answer challenge binding. Each agent must answer a fresh, system-generated puzzle whose solution depends on a secret saffron-tinted random seed, and submit the answer hashed with that seed. Answers cannot be copied because the seed changes per challenge and per identity. Any gale of duplicate submissions is discarded. An attacker must run full inference for every fake identity, paying compute equal to one real solve each time, so forging N sybils costs N full solves per epoch. Every voyage through the challenge costs the attacker one irreversible solve,
